other_failure_modes.name: Missing validation evaluation
other_failure_modes.description: The agent sets up a cross-validation loop and generates out-of-fold predictions, but entirely fails to evaluate the model's performance on the validation folds (e.g., never calculating or reporting the evaluation metric). This makes it impossible to assess model quality or generalization performance before submitting to a leaderboard.

summary: The agent sets up a robust feature engineering pipeline, successfully extracting text, numeric, and temporal features, and implements a multi-model stacking architecture. However, they make three notable errors: ignoring the temporal nature of the dataset by using a random cross-validation split, blending final predictions with an unweighted average without tuning, and failing to actually calculate or report any validation metric despite importing `roc_auc_score`.
